abstention_card.search_record: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA, bounded to the set searched. 'antisense' and 'oligonucleotide' were 0 in the 20-record splice-relevant census set (19 of 20 read at abstract depth; known-roads § 2.8, 2026-10-20), not across every WWOX record: the repository holds WWOX papers that use an antisense construct (PMID 19366691) or a morpholino knockdown (PMID 25649963), neither a splice-switching correction arm. A later three-query PubMed leg with a passing positive control (analysis/splice_allele_rna_evidence_20260922.md) supports the absence of an aberrant-to-normal ratio; PubMed zeros are not re-runnable offline. Of the 20 records three measured a transcript from a splice allele.

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
